# macOS — 37 policies

All policies are named `[Baseline] - MAC - <D|U> - <Item>`; the tables below show the `<Item>` part.

| Folder | Count |
|---|---:|
| `SettingsCatalog/` | 30 |
| `DeviceConfigurations/` | 3 |
| `CompliancePolicies/` | 4 |

Assign to device groups.

| [**Screensaver**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_MAC_D_Screensaver.en.md) | Requires the password no later than five seconds after the screen saver starts, and starts the screen saver after fifteen minutes of inactivity — including at the login window. | Settings Catalog | 4 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-200-MACDScreensaver` |
| [**Software Updates**](SettingsCatalog/Baseline_MAC_D_Software_Updates.en.md) | How and when macOS downloads and installs its own updates. | Settings Catalog | 16 | — | `INTUNE-BASE-047-MACDSoftwareUpdates` |

---

**What it does** comes from `doel` in [`_manifest.json`](../_manifest.json) (translated). The same Dutch
sentence sits, together with the assignment target and the origin, in the template's `Description`
field — and so later in the tenant next to the policy.

An empty **checkId** means the platform engine has no matcher for that policy type
(Device config, compliance, app protection) — see the [main README](../../README.en.md#which-types-produce-a-check).
